description: Finish a file added to a project (list_project_data shows those waiting): say what it is (title, source, year, licence: cc-by, cc0, cc-by-nc, other-open, restricted or unsure; item = the data-check item it fills), match its columns (`mapping`, {field: column}, e.g. {"scientificName": "species"}), run Biohotspot's checks and, unless accept is false, use it so it shows on the map and counts in the data check. What is not given keeps its current value. Returns the check's verdict. Needs owner or editor rights.

accept.description: Use it once the checks pass (default true)
